name: Walk It Off

benefit: Press {key} at 25+ Poison, Spores or Drowsy to remove 25 from the highest. Once per biome.

name: BingBong Parachute
benefit: Once per run, cancel a fatal fall and return to safe ground.
notes: Judges the whole fall, including Piton Payment Plan's delayed share, and cancels all of it.

name: Perma-Cooking
benefit: Food removes 25% more Hunger.

benefit: You receive a Book of Bones right now.

benefit: All carried weight is 60% lighter, including backpacks and scouts.
drawback: Your third pocket cannot hold new items.
notes: Now halves total weight and blocks new items in the third pocket; existing items remain retrievable. Enabled by default on a fresh config; previous Enabled=false is preserved.

name: Carry-On Only
benefit: Held items weigh 45% less.

name: Super Idol Hands
benefit: Held items weigh 65% less.

benefit: Cooked food fills you up 40% more, and once per biome your first cooked meal is not consumed.
notes: Preserved food stays in hand; no peel is spawned for the preserved use.

name: Cooked
benefit: Cooked food removes 60% more Hunger.

name: Balright
benefit: Get a mythic item (of your choice) at the next campfire. Once per run.

name: Otto-Matic Clutch

name: You're alright, you're alright
benefit: Pull teammates up from 40% farther away.
drawback: Starting a pull costs a base 5 stamina, once per continuous reach.

name: Take One for the Troop
benefit: Teammates within 8 m take 50% less Injury.

benefit: You and teammates within 8 m gain 10 maximum stamina.

benefit: Sprint 35% faster and jump 25% higher.

name: Scoutmaster
benefit: Climbing costs no stamina and falls cause no Injury. Sprint 25% faster.
